Reference image 2 is STYLE ONLY: match its rich cinematic photographic realism, believable weathered materials, smoky dark navy backdrop, warm amber key light and cool cyan rim light. Reinterpret the low-poly model as a physically plausible real-world military object, adding surface detail and engineering while retaining its unmistakable identity. Olive/forest-green paint, charcoal hardware, subtle pale mint identification lights. Dramatic close three-quarter view from slightly elevated camera, whole main silhouette and critical parts visible with 8-12% breathing room, centered and large enough to read at 100px wide. Ground objects on dark military concrete hardstand; airborne objects against dark smoky sky. Crisp subject, subtly defocused background, realistic metal/concrete/rubber. Quiet backdrop, no battle clutter obscuring silhouette. No Minecraft, no voxel, no low-poly or toy, no cartoon, no miniature diorama, no collage, no text, no labels, no UI, no border, no brand logo, no watermark, no flags, no gore. Do not copy people from style reference. Do not invent a different weapon or building. Subject requirements: A slim lightweight military scout helicopter: narrow long olive fuselage, small glazed angular nose cockpit, ONE four-bladed main rotor above the middle, long thin tail boom with a conventional tail rotor, simple landing skids, compact nose sensor/cannon. No broad wing pylons, keep a distinctly light reconnaissance helicopter silhouette. Flying low in a smoky battlefield sky, entire rotor span inside image.

items.label: Vulture
items.design: A conventional military rocket-attack helicopter: long narrow olive armored fuselage with angular cockpit nose, ONE four-bladed main rotor, long tail boom and conventional tail rotor, landing skids, compact stub weapons mounts with unguided rocket pods along the sides. Keep its reference's conventional slender helicopter silhouette, differentiate from the tiny scout by reinforced cockpit and rocket armament. Flying, rotors slightly motion blurred but airframe sharp.

items.label: Hammerhead
items.design: A broad heavy twin-rotor military gunship / VTOL: wide flattened armored olive central fuselage, broad connecting cross-wing, EXACTLY TWO large exposed four-blade lifting rotors mounted on left and right outriggers, paired short rear tail fins, substantial missile pods under the outer sides. Preserve the very wide side-by-side twin-rotor silhouette; not a tandem Chinook, not a standard single-rotor helicopter, not a quadcopter. Plausible cockpit and turbine nacelles, flying low, whole rotor spans visible.

items.label: Ore Collector
items.design: An industrial military ore-harvesting vehicle: heavy squat tracked olive machine with a broad front cylindrical excavation roller/scoop, armored glazed cab above front, open rear ore hopper visibly loaded with pale green mineral chunks, visible mechanical rollers and conveyor behind cab, reinforced railings and side tracks. Preserve collector layout and front mining drum; no cannon or tank turret.
